author: Cleo Abram
description:
Your map shows Antarctica wrong.

Antarctica is typically seen as a little sliver at the bottom of the map. No one lives there so most people don’t give it much thought, but if you were to flip a map of the world to place Antarctica at the center you get a much different view. This icy continent is way more important than most people realize for keeping our planet (and us!) healthy. 

To find out more, subscribe! 

#Antarctica #science #explainer #ocean
title: Your Map Shows Antarctica Wrong
